name: La Zarza-Perrunal (Spain)
description: Quartered white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Zarza-Perrunal (crossed tools, a tree, a monument and a helmet).
history: Municipal flag of La Zarza-Perrunal; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Zarza-Perrunal arms — crossed tools, tree, monument and helmet
